paragraphs: I moved to Boston from Mumbai a few months ago for grad school, and honestly, most days still feel a little unreal. Ryan came into my life right when I was trying to figure out my classes, my commute, all of it, and he makes the city feel less lonely. He works in tech, so he’s always got this easy confidence, like he already knows where the good places are.

Last weekend he took me out to the coast without telling me where we were going, and I laughed the whole drive because he kept saying, “Just trust me, it’ll be fun.” It was fun. He’s like that a lot, always turning a normal Saturday into something bigger, something I’d remember.

He says a quiet life would kill him, which sounds dramatic, but with him it mostly sounds alive. He’s also really into my outfits. In a cute way, mostly. He’ll say things like, “You’d look amazing in something more fitted,” or “I bet you’d rock a different style.” I know he means well, and sometimes I do like the attention, especially when I’m wearing my kurtis and he says I look beautiful in them too.

He keeps talking about “our future place” and how amazing it’ll look with Indian touches, which is sweet, even if I’m not exactly thinking that far ahead yet. The only little thing is that he always wants to know my schedule before the weekend, and if I mention a community meet-up or dinner with friends, he gets this disappointed face and says, “Come on, babe, don’t waste a good night.”

I usually end up changing plans because he’s already made something exciting. Maybe I’m just not used to someone being this intentional. But I did notice I’ve started checking with him before I say yes to anything. Is it weird that I keep letting his plans win?
